analysis.reasonEn: RSI has moved out of oversold territory into neutral, but MACD histogram improvement has stalled, showing sideways movement. While the 5-day low is holding, the price is failing to break above the 20-day high, indicating a lack of clear direction, thus a wait-and-see approach is warranted.

keyPointsEn: RSI exited oversold but MACD improvement stalled, indicating lack of direction.
5-day low support confirmed, but failure to break 20-day high enters resistance zone.
Volume ratio of 0.72 suggests weak buying pressure; maintaining a wait-and-see approach.
analysis.riskNote: ADX 15.8로 추세 미형성 구간에서 변동성이 확대될 경우 급락 위험 존재.
